attributes.action: Ban noisy fireworks completely in the uk
attributes.additional_details: My poor dog and others have been traumatised by the noises and it’s taken 2 weeks for her to recover. Then there’s the wildlife and farm animals.
attributes.background: I want the government to outlaw all fireworks that use explosives and make a loud noise and leave smoke trails

rejection.details:
We already have a petition open on this subject which you may wish to sign:

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
